$comment: Malformed examples and the problems both validators (src/protocol/validate.js, threemaze/link/validate.py) must report for each: exactly these, as (path, keyword) pairs sorted by path and keyword. invalid/ holds messages, invalid-text/ raw frame texts.

invalid/unknown-type.json.why: a type that version 1 does not have

invalid/t-float-ms.json.why: t in milliseconds with a fraction, not whole microseconds

invalid/t-negative.json.why: a monotonic clock in microseconds is never negative here

invalid/t-beyond-2-53.json.why: an integer JavaScript cannot hold exactly

invalid/envelope-seq.json.why: an envelope field version 1 does not have

invalid/heartbeat-with-id.json.why: a heartbeat is not a request

invalid/hello-without-id.json.why: hello is a request and needs an id

invalid/hello-wrong-protocol.json.why: the protocol name of the 2026-10 design sketch

invalid/hello-role-renderer.json.why: the render host never connects itself (ADR-0003 1a)

invalid/hello-motion-without-session.jso.why: a motion client names its session

invalid/hello-motion-without-versions.js.why: a motion client gives its renderer and physics versions for the session record

invalid/hello-version-component-path.jso.why: a component id with a slash

invalid/welcome-heartbeat-1000.json.why: the design sketch's 1 s heartbeat cannot serve a 100 ms watchdog

invalid/welcome-motion-without-device.js.why: a motion client learns the device's guarantees

invalid/welcome-motion-without-world.jso.why: a motion client learns the world it starts in (rule C4)

invalid/welcome-session-path.json.why: a session is a name, not a folder

invalid/session-state-experiment-file.js.why: experiments are named by registry id, not by file

invalid/session-state-running-without-se.why: every state but idle names its session

invalid/session-state-telemetry-gain.jso.why: the v1 path has no gain estimate (ADR-0003 1d)

invalid/sample-velocity.json.why: v0.3's velocity payload: samples carry displacements

invalid/sample-raw-17-axes.json.why: a device has at most 16 axes

invalid/sample-batch-empty.json.why: a batch holds at least one sample

invalid/sample-without-gap.json.why: every sample says how many were lost before it

invalid/pose-batch-without-world.json.why: poses name their world (plan item TS-09)

invalid/event-zone-without-edge.json.why: a zone event says enter or exit

invalid/event-zone-with-lost.json.why: a field of another event kind

invalid/event-without-world.json.why: events name their world (plan item TS-09)

invalid/event-kind-contact.json.why: an event kind version 1 does not have

invalid/event-seq-gap-zero.json.why: a gap loses at least one sample

invalid/render-clock-gain.json.why: the v1 clock check has no gain field (plan item REN-4)

invalid/render-frames-without-world.json.why: frame batches name their world (plan item TS-09)

invalid/render-long-task-source-url.json.why: script attribution would carry file URLs

invalid/render-ready-setting-path.json.why: a setting names a constant, never a file

invalid/error-message-py-name.json.why: no .py names in text, in any letter case

invalid/error-message-line-separator.jso.why: U+2028 ends a line for JavaScript and for Python's str.splitlines

invalid/error-path-not-pointer.json.why: a pointer into the message, never a file path

invalid/id-trailing-newline.json.why: Python's $ would accept this; the patterns end in (?![\s\S])

invalid/ack-with-field.json.why: the core subset's ack carries no fields

invalid-text/overflow.txt.why: 1e400 parses to an infinite number in JavaScript and Python

invalid-text/integer-overflow.txt.why: a 401-digit integer is an infinite number in JavaScript; Python must refuse it too

invalid-text/not-an-object.txt.why: one message per frame, as an object
